answer: At each governance pulse, votes are weighted by escrowed stake, not identity count, and funds remain locked for a 30-day horizon. Creating a gale of fake agents adds no voting power: splitting 100 tokens across 1,000 names still yields only 100 tokens of weight. To gain influence, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more capital, bearing token-price risk and forgoing other uses of those funds during the lock.
